snippet.title: The Last Transmission Trailer
snippet.description:
Find the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3684440/The_Last_Transmission/

The Last Transmission is a psychological horror game.

You are the last operator at a remote radio station.
You monitor transmissions. You file reports.

Then a voice cuts through the static.

Something on the line is listening.

Playable experience. No combat. No jumpscares.
Just isolation, routine and what happens when it breaks.
